name: portal-direccion-academica-hrrg
description: Portal institucional de la Dirección Académica — Docencia e Investigación, Hospital Regional Río Gallegos.

scripts.serve: node --run build && node -e "import('node:http').then(async({default:h})=>{const{readFile}=await import('node:fs/promises');const p=await import('node:path');const t={'.html':'text/html','.css':'text/css','.js':'text/javascript','.png':'image/png','.svg':'image/svg+xml','.json':'application/json','.woff2':'font/woff2'};h.createServer(async(q,s)=>{let f=p.join('dist',decodeURIComponent(q.url.split('?')[0]));if(f.endsWith('/'))f+='index.html';try{s.writeHead(200,{'content-type':t[p.extname(f)]||'application/octet-stream'});s.end(await readFile(f))}catch{s.writeHead(404);s.end(await readFile('dist/404.html').catch(()=>'404'))}}).listen(4173,()=>console.log('http://localhost:4173/'))})"
